name: Crafting Table
unlock: Construction (XP 12); station page does not list a skill-level or item unlock.
description: Basic tools, weapons, ammo, some armour and capes. No indoor/outdoor restriction. No foundation required.

name: Armour Bench
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a bronze bar. Replaced part of Smithing Anvil / Crafting Table / Jeweler's Bench (0.12.0).
description: Head, body, leg armour (melee, magic, ranged) and most capes.

name: Blacksmith's Bench
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a bronze bar. Replaced Smithing Anvil (0.12.0).
description: Tools and melee weapons above stone tier. Fuel pellets are also listed here (wiki Bucket also has a misspelled 'Blacksmith Bench' row).

name: Fletching Bench
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain flax. Must have a roof to use. No foundation required.
description: Bows, crossbows, arrows, bolts.

name: Mystic Forge
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a bronze bar.
description: Staves, some weapons, skillcapes, powerful capes. Also used to ascend masterworks and vestiges with ascension cores.

name: Rune Altar
unlock: Construction (XP 20); Wiki page does not state a skill-level or item unlock for the station itself. Runes still have Runecrafting levels (see Recipes).
description: Crafts runes from rune essence. Auto-craft or attunement minigame for more XP. No placement restrictions.

name: Jeweler's Bench
unlock: Construction (XP 15); Obtain a silver bar for the first time.
description: Rings and amulets.

name: Pottery Wheel
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Pick up clay for the first time.
description: Unfired clay forms. Fire them in the kiln. Wiki description still mentions a furnace; current kiln page is the firing station.

name: Brewing Cauldron
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Pick up clay for the first time. Became a crafting station (was processing) in 0.11.0.
description: Potions. No shelter restriction. No foundation required. Draws from nearby linked storage.

name: Campfire
unlock: Construction (XP 12); No extra unlock listed. Must NOT have a roof.
description: Basic cooking and boiling dirty water. Needs fuel (ash logs, charcoal, etc). Can burn food. Starts with 1 ash log in the fuel slot.

name: Grill
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Cooking 26 perk Grill Master.
description: Same basic foods as campfire, no fuel. Can still burn food.

name: Stone Range
unlock: Construction (XP 8); Build and interact with a campfire, or pick up an animal bone. Must have a roof.
description: Lower-tier combined meals and infusions. Cooking 11 Fancy Cookware unlocks pan rack, not this station.

name: Cooking Range
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Cooking 16. Wiki: you must also interact with a campfire at a cooking level, and have the build materials, before it appears in the build menu. Must have a roof.
description: Wider meal set than stone range. Amateur Culinaromancer (16) and Adept Culinaromancer (36) unlock extra range-only meals.

name: Spinning Wheel
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Harvest flax for the first time. Must have a roof.
description: Fibres and furs into thread. Slow processor.

name: Advanced Spinning Wheel
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Added 1.0 (15 Sep 2026). Wiki page is a stub; unlock not stated. Build recipe on wiki is identical to the basic spinning wheel.
description: Processes fibres. Bucket has one product: Vis Fibres (Harmonised Compound x3; Ground Rune Essence x3).

name: Tannery
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Pick up an animal bone.
description: Hides into leather. Slow. Upgrade with Tanner's Kit for two-ingredient recipes (hard leather). Kit does NOT grant Advanced Tannery recipes.

name: Advanced Tannery
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain yew logs for the first time.
description: Tougher hides (e.g. black dragon leather).

name: Tanner's Kit
unlock: Construction (XP 15); Obtain adhesive. Place within range of a tannery (one kit per tannery).
description: Adds a slot to the tannery for more complex materials such as hard leather.

name: Kiln
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Pick up clay. Superheat speeds it up.
description: Logs to charcoal, swamp tar to adhesive, fires clay, anima-infused bark to wild anima. Also Harmonised Compound from Discordant Residue x3.

name: Loom
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a bronze bar. Must have a roof.
description: Rough / wool / mystic cloth. Loom Harness adds a slot for padded, fine, infinity, desert, vis cloth.

name: Loom Harness
unlock: Construction (XP 15); Wiki: gather iron ore and smelt an iron bar. Place within 9 m of a loom. One harness per loom.
description: Extra loom slot.

name: Furnace
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Have tin or copper ore in inventory. Must NOT have a roof. Superheat speeds it up. Fuel: charcoal (wiki); Bucket recipes do not list fuel as an ingredient.
description: Smelts bronze/iron/etc. Description says it fires clay; wiki says it currently cannot.

name: Blast Furnace
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain coal for the first time. Must NOT have a roof. Superheat speeds it up. Fuel: fuel pellets.
description: Higher-tier bars (steel, mithril, adamant, rune, etc).

name: Grindstone
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain granite. Must NOT have a roof.
description: Grinds stone, sandstone, granite, bones, rune essence, dragon tooth.

name: Sawmill
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a bronze bar. Must NOT have a roof. Lumber storage within 5 m auto-deposits planks.
description: Logs to planks.

name: Stonecutter
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain a steel bar for the first time.
description: 2 stone -> 1 stone block (power level 3 building pieces).

name: Imbuing Barrel
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Obtain yew logs. Fuel: wild anima (4 anima-infused bark in the kiln). 1 wild anima processes 6 potions in 12 minutes.
description: Turns potions into super potions.

name: Compost Bin
unlock: Construction (XP 12); Farming 10.
description: Turns compostable items into compost in 5 seconds. Empty compost bucket to collect.

name: Super Compost Bin
unlock: Construction (XP ); Farming 60. Smaller input pool (includes willow logs).
description: Produces super compost.

name: Cooking Pot
unlock: REMOVED. Removed in Eye on Ashenfall 0.9.1. Replaced by Stone Range.
description: Bucket still has 1 leftover recipe (Redberry Crunchies) tagged to this station. Do not treat as live.

name: Smithing Anvil
unlock: REMOVED. Removed 23 June 2026 (0.12.0). Function moved to Armour Bench, Blacksmith's Bench, Fletching Bench, Mystic Forge.
description: Build recipe was the same as the three bronze benches.

name: Build Menu
description: Direct construction menu.

name: Edna
description: Recipe facility listed by the wiki; no station details in the research table.

name: Lougrim's Shrine
description: Recipe facility listed by the wiki; no station details in the research table.
